observations: Risk screening: target A only. Primary study DOI10.1186/s12936-021-03993-8 reports A25mg/kg without apparent toxicity over24h, whereas B1mg/kg was lethal. B is introductory comparison and excluded from synthesis dataset; this is not a general safety claim.
